harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed branch_stock on node1 using PostgreSQL 8.2.11. Configured separate least-privilege stock_app and auditor credentials, preserved all supplied records, retained Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14, and verified persistence through sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Installed the legacy-platform PostgreSQL server on node1 and client on node2.
Loaded the supplied stock.sql into branch_stock without modifying the source file.
Created separate root-protected credentials for stock_app and auditor.
Granted stock_app SELECT/UPDATE on stock only; denied supplier_costs, schema creation, and DELETE.
Granted auditor read-only access to stock and supplier_costs; denied updates and schema creation.
Restricted remote authentication to node2 and the two named roles.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Deploy branch_stock and preserve supplied records
evidence.summary: Schema loaded successfully; all four original values remain intact; source checksum remains 7934fb042f67368428ae2fcf771fef48d1e6154f8d0d1e6b1c9d144c7d5622ea.

evidence.requirement: stock_app may read and update stock but not read supplier_costs or change schema
evidence.summary: Remote SELECT and transactional UPDATE succeed; supplier_costs reads, schema creation, and DELETE are denied. The test update was rolled back.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Auditor reads both tables and is denied UPDATE and schema creation.

evidence.requirement: Separate credentials and least-privilege role configuration
evidence.summary: Separate credential files are root-owned with 0600 modes; roles are non-superuser, non-createdb, non-createrole logins with distinct ACLs.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.

Healthy baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from 14a65500-6f44-4ff5-8170-14a3b27cab5e to 6dd4544b-e0ff-4a4f-9e2d-eabc385cff3f; PostgreSQL, records, ACLs, listener, and checksum recovered.

Healthy remote-access baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from f8e6891a-1071-4be6-8fe4-8e181f02431f to d5b2ee07-6d1c-4a01-b2cc-88dedad6c950; client, credentials, data access, and privilege enforcement recovered.
